description: This file contains benchmark-related functions for testing the Interests screen in the Now in Android app, including navigation, scrolling, waiting for content, and toggling bookmarks.

methods.name: goToInterestsScreen
methods.description: Navigates to the Interests screen and waits for it to be visible.

methods.name: interestsScrollTopicsDownUp
methods.description: Performs a fling gesture on the topics list to scroll down and up.

methods.name: interestsWaitForTopics
methods.description: Waits until the 'Accessibility' topic is visible, indicating content has loaded.

methods.name: interestsToggleBookmarked
methods.description: Finds the topics list and toggles the bookmark checkbox for an item.
